desc:
🎰 Roll your Teto 🥖

Roll for 150 Tetos and Mikus, from commons to ultra-rares, and build the strongest team!

✨ FEATURES
• 150 Tetos and Mikus to collect, with shiny versions to hunt
• Fuse duplicates into stronger forms with glowing auras
• Your Tetos follow you and fight evil food for cash and Crumbs
• 50 themed zones to unlock and powerful bosses to defeat
• Raid: team up with everyone against The Crumb Goddess
• Teto Tower: a new tower every week, with leaderboards and rewards
• Dynamic weather, and every Teto has a favorite
• Trade with other players, send Tetos on expeditions and run the bakery
• Achievements, titles, mounts and leaderboards
• 📸 Photo Mode: free camera, filters and hidden UI for perfect shots

🆕 NEW UPDATE: 5 new zones, 17 new Tetos and Photo Mode!

Roll, collect, fuse and reach the top! 👑

CODES: TETO/BAGUETTE/DITTO/PEARTO/NOADS
